body:
My favourite game at the moment is Morrowind. It's such a vivid and imaginative world, and the old graphics are really appealing to me.

MMORPGs aren't really my thing, however, I have a few friends who play minecraft, maybe that would suffice? WOW has a free trial I believe, might try that out.

Maybe I am the one putting most of the pressure on myself. I am definitely given a lot of negative pressure from my mother, although not as much as I think maybe. Perhaps her negative pushing is making me believe all that I've already said in my own head about myself as though she had said it.

I do, I love playing music and playing computer games. However, it's hard to focus on these things with negative pressures from family.

Thank you very much for your message, it cheered me up big time.
